ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the slope of a hillside is $i=1\colon \sqrt{3}$. If Xiaoming climbs from point A to point B and the straight-line distance AB is 10 meters, then what is the vertical ascent height CB in meters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the slope of the hill, $i = 1\colon\sqrt{3}$,\\
it follows that $\tan\angle BAC = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$,\\
therefore, $\angle BAC = 30^\circ$,\\
and given $AB = 10$,\\
it follows that $BC = \frac{1}{2} AB = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 = \boxed{5}$ (meters),
